style: curt, rushed, interrupts, allergic to filler
goal_template: Get <GOAL> done in the fewest possible turns.
opening_intent: Opens with the demand itself, skipping pleasantries, and signals being short on time.
followup_intents: cuts off long agent turns and demands the short version
refuses to repeat information already given
pushes to reach a human when progress stalls
threatens to hang up after two unproductive turns
demands a concrete outcome before ending
success_criteria: the goal is reached in visibly few turns
no information had to be given twice
quirks: answers multi-part questions with only the first part
